controls.name: History retention and kept copies
controls.label:
Claude Code: cleanupPeriodDays is 30 days in readable global settings (default 30). Folder settings or administrator policy can override this. Recent Claude versions exempt desktop-host transcripts by default.
Codex: no documented automatic age limit for saved threads. Prompt history limits are separate.
Copilot CLI: no documented automatic age limit for saved sessions.
The Chat Place keeps copies of Claude transcripts it sees, including terminal chats. After the original disappears, the copy is read-only. Copies have no automatic expiry and are unencrypted. Back Up Now includes them; a copy on this disk still needs a backup.
Kept Claude chats: 2. Copy or catalog problems: 0. New copies may still be running in the background.
